SELECT S.SUBMIT_NO , S.REQ_DT , NVL(C.CODE_NM, '미지정') AS REQ_STS_NM , CASE WHEN S.REQ_STS_CD = '01' THEN '신청' WHEN S.REQ_STS_CD = '02' THEN '취소' ELSE '기타' END AS STS_TXT FROM TB_SUBMIT S LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.CODE_ID = S.REQ_STS_CD
S.REQ_DT BETWEEN #{startDt} AND #{endDt} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND S.REQ_STS_CD = #{reqStsCd}
AND S.SUBMIT_NO LIKE '%' || #{submitNo} || '%'
ORDER BY S.REQ_DT DESC, S.SUBMIT_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SUBMIT SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SUBMIT_NO = #{submitNo}
